heroHeadline: Kyauktaw Market Airstrike Toll Hits 49–50 as UN Voices Alarm — Day 2,068
heroSubtitle: The death toll from the Sept 28 junta airstrike on Kyauktaw's wholesale market in Rakhine State has risen to at least 49, with 58 wounded; the Arakan Army puts it at 50. The UN said it was alarmed, and the Arakan Army vowed retaliation.
